todo-paper/features/customizable_title_d: Add a custom title to your todo list or leave it blank for a clean look.
todo-paper/features/flexible_group_size_: Choose from 3-6 tasks per group. Comfortable mode shows 2 columns, Compact mode shows 3 columns per row.
todo-paper/features/minor_tasks_desc: Mark some tasks as minor with a lighter style for less important items.
todo-paper/features/print_ready_desc: Optimized for A4 paper, ready to print or save as PDF.
todo-paper/how_to_use/step1: Enter a title for your todo list (optional, leave blank to hide).
todo-paper/how_to_use/step2: Choose the number of tasks per group and select density mode (Comfortable: 2 columns, Compact: 3 columns).
todo-paper/how_to_use/step3: Optionally enable minor tasks and set how many tasks per group should be styled as minor (lighter appearance).
todo-paper/how_to_use/step4: Click the Print button to print your todo list or save as PDF.
todo-paper/note: Generate printable A4 todo list templates with customizable task groups and minor tasks.
todo-paper/tags: todo list, printable, planner, productivity, paper template
